git_rationale.root_cause_commit: B2: dev-report-20260505-231740-W6 (hook landed Write|Edit only) + cab2600 (parent cycle missing settings.json wiring)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Architect concern_6 bound the W6 dev to a single hook file, which was honored — but the hook's existing case lattice covered only Write|Edit. The Bash dispatch case was never enumerated because data agents are forbidden from using Write/Edit. Settings.json wiring was assumed but never verified (zero grep hits in both project and global). Python-internal write surface in sync-agent-data.py + strip-image-url-fields.py was uncovered because a Bash PreToolUse hook physically cannot inspect Python-internal open() calls.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Defense-in-depth across 4 layers: (1) Bash branch in same hook file catches direct shell redirects + save.py invocations. (2) settings.json registers the hook so it actually fires at runtime. (3) json_io.save_agent_json runs ownership + image_url rejectors on EVERY persistence call, catching Python-internal writes invisible to Bash. (4) sync-agent-data.py + strip-image-url-fields.py refactored to route through save_agent_json so the rejectors fire on their writes. Each layer is independent; bypassing one still trips the next.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Iter 2 W2 spans 4 enforcement layers (Bash hook + settings.json + json_io extension + 2 script refactors) per QA's investigation_completeness objections. Each layer is independent and addresses a different bypass surface. Hook Bash branch is ~195 lines because it must duplicate parsing logic the embedded Python script needs (different runtime than json_io's Python). json_io extension is ~134 lines because the gate broke each helper into ≤30-line functions to satisfy the project quality gate. Test files (~256 lines combined) are mandated by AC-OWNERSHIP and AC2 reformulated recipes. The smallest correct fix at 4 layers cannot be smaller than ~400 lines; 576 reflects the per-helper splitting required by quality gate. Spec explicitly authorizes this scope (worker_partition.W2-enforcement-runtime-wiring estimated 180 lines for the policy-relevant additions; tests + helper-splitting account for the remainder).
